text:
Ava: idea: nudge registrants 48h before to pick a breakout track so we can size support and personalize CTAs. quick format: 1 short email + 1 in-platform banner + optional SMS for high-value leads. thoughts?

Marcus: yes. two experiments: (A) soft nudge: "Which track will you join?" and (B) incentive nudge: "Reserve a seat in the lab (limited)". measure pickup rate and change in attendance by track.

June: copy suggestions: soft nudge subject = 'Pick your track: hands-on lab or benchmarks' / incentive subject = 'Reserve your lab seat — limited RSVP'. include a one-click RSVP link that updates attendee's selection.

Ibrahim: ops ask: the RSVP link should pre-populate into webinar platform so breakout counts are accurate. also add hidden field for "willing to be contacted by solutions" to route SDRs.

Marcus: cadence: initial nudge 48h out, reminder 6h before with pre-install checklist for lab, morning-of 1h banner with link to switch track. track-switching analytics -> tag in CRM.

June: fallback if lab fills: show waitlist with "join office-hours" option. also prepare a short prerecorded lab we can stream to everyone if needed.

Ava: rehearsal note: include a 10m run for RSVP flow in the full dress. confirm volunteers for support sizing after the first nudge test.

Ibrahim: reminder-bot: can you schedule the 48h and 6h nudges for the upcoming webinar (ID 2025-08-12)?

reminder-bot: Scheduled: "Nudge: Track selection (48h)" on 2025-08-10 17:00 UTC and "Nudge: Track selection (6h)" on 2025-08-12 11:00 UTC.

Ava: perfect — we'll A/B the incentive vs soft nudge and report back. keep this thread for tracking the experiment only. thanks! :white_check_mark:
